card.name: Withhold-until dose modification wording
card.fires_on: Words in toxicity-based dose adjustment tables, right before "until" or a lab threshold. Includes the end of a brand name after Withhold or Interrupt, and words like weekly or days.

modes.label: Brand name after Withhold
modes.description: Last piece of a brand drug name right after Withhold, Hold or Interrupt, before "until".
modes.example: Grade 3 Withhold TABRECT<<A>> until recovery to baseline bilirubin

modes.label: Monitoring frequency or duration
modes.description: Time words in a hold or monitoring instruction, ahead of "until" recovery.
modes.example: monitor blood counts<< weekly>> until neutrophil counts return to ≥

modes.label: Grade table thresholds
modes.description: Words or spaces just before a numeric lab or grade cutoff in a dosing table.
